options.name: Descriptive Language
options.description: Use vivid adjectives and adverbs to paint a picture
options.prompt: Descriptive Language: Use vivid adjectives and adverbs to paint a picture. For example a lush landscape, a gripping story.

options.name: Informative Tone
options.description: Focus on clarity and factual information
options.prompt: Informative Tone: Focus on clarity and factual information. For example according to recent studies.

options.name: Engaging Questions
options.description: Pose rhetorical questions to provoke thought
options.prompt: Engaging Questions: Pose rhetorical questions to provoke thought. For example what drives human curiosity?

options.name: Clear and Concise
options.examples: Let's explore, In this lesson, we will...
options.prompt: Clear and Concise: Use straightforward vocabulary. For example let's explore, in this lesson, we will...

options.name: Technical Terms
options.examples: Photosynthesis is the process by which...
options.prompt: Technical Terms: Introduce jargon but provide definitions. For example photosynthesis is the process by which...

options.name: Encouraging Phrases
options.examples: You can do this!, Let's dive deeper!
options.prompt: Encouraging Phrases: Use motivational language. For example you can do this!, let's dive deeper!

options.name: Persuasive Language
options.description: Use compelling adjectives and action verbs
options.examples: Transform your life with..., Discover the benefits of...
options.prompt: Persuasive Language: Use compelling adjectives and action verbs. For example transform your life with..., discover the benefits of...

options.name: Call to Action
options.examples: Sign up today!, Don't miss out!
options.prompt: Call to Action: Direct phrases urging immediate response. For example sign up today!, don't miss out!

options.name: Positive Tone
options.examples: Join our community of satisfied customers!
options.prompt: Positive Tone: Emphasize benefits and positive outcomes. For example join our community of satisfied customers!

options.name: Character-Specific

options.prompt: Character-Specific: Tailor language to reflect character backgrounds and personalities. For example formal language for noble characters, slang for streetwise characters.

options.name: Emotional Expression

options.prompt: Emotional Expression: Use expressive language to convey feelings. For example I can't believe this is happening!

options.prompt: Imagery and Metaphors: Employ figurative language to enhance storytelling. For example her smile was like sunshine on a rainy day.
